issues: React dev warning across every page: 'A props object containing a key prop is being spread into JSX' — appears from NavItem + BottomTab components. Non-blocking but pollutes the console and will become an error in a future React major. Fix by destructuring key out of props before spread.

action_items: OPTIONAL cleanup: destructure `key` out of props before {...props} spread in NavItem (AdvertiserShell.jsx) + BottomTab (RadioHome.jsx or bottom-strip component) to silence the React key-in-spread dev warning.
critical_code_review_comments: OBSERVATION: /api/advertiser-app/{id}/scan endpoint returns HTTP 200 with {ok:false, reason:'wrong_advertiser_scope'} for scope mismatches instead of a 4xx status code. The /redeem twin correctly returns 403 for the same condition. This is intentional (preview is non-mutating and should not throw) but the asymmetry could confuse API consumers — consider documenting or adjusting to 200 with ok:false for both.

OBSERVATION: The `resolve_advertiser_with_role` helper returns 403 with code='not_advertiser_member' for the non-member case, but the FastAPI wrapper puts the payload under `detail`. Tests must unwrap `.get('detail').get('code')`. Consider a global exception handler that flattens the payload for simpler client parsing.

SUGGESTION: `advertiser_scan` route has multiple 200-with-ok:false branches (not_found / wrong_advertiser_scope / already_redeemed / revoked / expired / invalid_status_*). Consider extracting these into a shared enum + response wrapper for consistency with future scan surfaces (e.g., MER.2 cashier).

MINOR: `_lookup_coupon_by_code_or_qr` does `up = raw.upper()` and queries $or for both raw + up on coupon_id/code/short_code. That's 6 arms per lookup; a case-insensitive collation on the coupons.code index would be cleaner (and works with the existing index).
MINOR (RL.2): RadioHome.jsx BottomStrip iterates items with {...item} spread — that's the source of the React key-in-spread warning. Change to <BottomTab key={i} label={item.label} ... />.
